best_idea: Pair two hubs, route one street between them, cut a river across the middle of that street with bridges where they meet (half carry a barrier), then fill each hub's ring with capped services and plots.
decision_why: Street-first-then-cut gives a zone one readable road and one chokepoint from small data; adapt because it must run on the server with Frankendom pathing and because the factory counter and its first-factory check are defective.
acceptance: A player sees one road between the two hubs with a river across its middle and a bridge where they cross; a server test asserts every street tile crossing the river is a bridge, barriers appear only on bridges, and each hub has at most two factory-type buildings.
